hypotheses.physical_signature: Steerable odd-symmetric fault-step vs even-symmetric volcanic-dike/paleochannel quadrature phase-asymmetry A_step = (||grad_n phi|| - |d^2_nn phi|) / (||grad_n phi|| + |d^2_nn phi| + eps) on vector gravity (Bands 11, 13, 18) and RTP/TMI_up150 (Band 2 + ext Band 4), bilinearly pulled back up-dip along footwall-directed (-grad Z_b) vectors by clip((Z_b/100)*cot(60 deg), 0, 8 px) onto surface fault emergence; coupled with oriented seismic-lineation structure-tensor anisotropy (Bands 10, 16) projected onto Kostrov normal-dilation/Riedel-shear strain rates (Bands 7, 8), multi-altitude FFT Salem tilt-zero dip-migration, up-hydraulic-head advected DOE GDR #1391 silica/cation geothermometry + 2-m probe thermal walls + paleo-sinter vents, 6 anisotropic Kostrov-Pollard fracture-mechanics fields, Elkan (2001) Bayes prior-odds calibration + cover-aware Noisy-OR fusion, and Exact 6-Ring Bernoulli Survival Supremum Self-Credit Dinkelbach-CELF allocation.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Concealed intrabasin normal faults and blind geothermal conduits dip 55-65 deg beneath Quaternary alluvium (displacing subsurface gravity/magnetic/MT steps 400-800 m basinward of surface emergence), while Miocene Northern Nevada Rift mafic dike swarms generate strong even-symmetric magnetic/gravity ridges that trigger isotropic gradient and Riesz amplitude detectors. Pulling odd-symmetric step phase up-dip to surface emergence and fusing via cover-aware Elkan-Bayes calibration recovers both concealed basin-floor conduits (SGMC-PROXY-DTI) and unmapped range-tip/relay extensions (HOLDOUT-DTI) without concentrating >70% of dots on legacy catalogue collars.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: (1) Miocene Northern Nevada Rift basaltic dike swarms and buried alluvial paleochannels (even-symmetric phi in {0, pi} ridges/troughs, suppressed by odd-minus-even quadrature step filter A_step); (2) Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (1,180-1,345 m ASL) wave-cut shorelines and GeoDAWN flight-block leveling seams (vetoed via acquisition_block_id_100m.tif and elevation contour-parallelism); (3) down-slope shallow groundwater thermal outflow plumes (mitigated via up-hydraulic-head back-projection).
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Resolves the exact structural trade-off between H86I-KSAD (which achieved 0.1599 HOLDOUT-DTI via Elkan-Bayes coupled Kostrov-Pollard trees but failed the 0.70 discrete overlap gate at 0.7131 due to collar=2.6 px, min_sep=2.4 px, and unpulled static features) and H86K-STDP (which achieved 0.3711 max overlap and 0.1133 SGMC-PROXY-DTI via up-dip pullback + 6-ring Dinkelbach-CELF at collar=3.0 px, spacing=2.8 px, but dropped to 0.1380 HOLDOUT-DTI because quadrant-IQR normalization erased natural SW/SE fold base rates and omitted steerable odd-step vs even-dike discrimination and 6-plane Kostrov-Pollard coupling).
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~18 min CPU, <900 MiB RAM via float16 memmaps; 100% SHA-pinned data already restored and verified in sandbox)

hypotheses.name: Microseismic-Hypocentral Lineation Structure Tensor & Geodetic Transtensional Coulomb Stress-Rate Coupling
hypotheses.physical_signature: 2-D structure-tensor anisotropy ((lambda_1 - lambda_2)/(lambda_1 + lambda_2)) and principal strike director of log-transformed earthquake density (Band 10) and inverse distance (Band 16) projected onto Kostrov normal-dilation and Riedel transtensional shear strain rates (Bands 7, 8).
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Active accommodation-zone transfer faults and blind Walker Lane / Humboldt structural zone stepovers creep and host linear microseismic streaks beneath unbroken Quaternary playfairways without forming single range-front scarps.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Isotropic geothermal injection swarms, mining/quarry blasts, or broad catalog kernel smoothing halos (suppressed by requiring high structure-tensor eccentricity and transtensional azimuth alignment).
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Prior lanes (H86I-KSAD, H86K-STDP) used scalar products or differences of Bands 10 and 16; none extracted the oriented 2-D seismic structure tensor and projected its strike onto the geodetic Kostrov strain tensor (core plane incorporated as feature 14 in H86N-SHPB).
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (native bands only; core operator integrated into H86N-SHPB)

hypotheses.name: Listric Hanging-Wall Rollover Antithetic Fiber-Bending Curvature & Conductive Clay-Cap Seal Termination
hypotheses.physical_signature: Directional hanging-wall rollover bending strain -d^2(Z_b)/du^2 at 1.5-3.5 km basinward standoff coupled with lateral termination of high surface conductance (Band 17 smectite clay cap).
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Antithetic keystone faults in hanging-wall rollover anticlines nucleate 1.5-3.5 km basinward of mapped master range-front faults and trap blind geothermal upflow beneath electrically conductive smectite clay caps.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Differential compaction synclines over buried bedrock highs and saline playa margins.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Couples directional Xiao-Suppe rollover curvature with lateral clay-cap conductance termination rather than isotropic biharmonic nabla^4(Z_b) (H86I-HVFD) or raw conductivity necks (H86M-CNT).
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-Medium (obtainable on existing stack; core rollover hinge incorporated in H86N-SHPB)

hypotheses.name: ARIA/COMET Sentinel-1 Ascending+Descending InSAR Vertical Subsidence & Fault-Parallel Creep-Gradient Step
layers: External official public-domain source required: NASA/JPL ARIA Sentinel-1 Geocoded Unwrapped Interferograms (ASF DAAC https://asf.alaska.edu/data-sets/derived-data-sets/insar/) & COMET LiCSAR Nevada frame 064A_05054_131313 (https://comet.nerc.ac.uk/COMET-LiCS-portal/)
hypotheses.physical_signature: 100 m high-pass vertical deformation phase-gradient step across blind intrabasin faults acting as hydraulic compartment barriers and aseismic creep planes.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Blind intrabasin faults compartmentalize basin groundwater and geothermal reservoirs, producing sharp 100 m-scale InSAR vertical deformation steps across flat playas with zero topographic scarp.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Agricultural center-pivot pumping cones and seasonal playa evaporite swelling.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Native Bands 4, 7, 8 are long-wavelength (~10-20 km) GPS station interpolations (Hammond et al. 2016) that cannot resolve 100 m intrabasin hydraulic-barrier phase steps.
hypotheses.external_source_obtainability: Official free public-domain NASA ASF DAAC / COMET LiCSAR products verified by URL, but NOT directly downloadable inside this sandbox because outbound internet access is restricted to github.com/codeload.github.com/api.github.com/pypi.org/npmjs.org and no SHA-pinned Sentinel-1 InSAR raster mirror exists in buffedlizard55-lab/*. Explicitly deferred per protocol rather than simulated.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High (requires external workstation download + EPSG:32611 100 m phase unwrapping/projection)
